_comment: Gzipped budget for the production frontend build, enforced by
scripts/ci/check_bundle_size.py. Raising a number here is a visible diff
that has to be justified in the pull request that raises it.
Re-baselined by E1-04 against the first real production build — the ticket
that landed the scaffold and made this gate enforcing. That build measured
85,364 bytes gzipped for the entry chunk and 87,701 for the whole initial
payload (that chunk plus the stylesheet), and the two numbers below are
128 KB and 160 KB: about half again, and about double. The headroom is what
the five empty landing views grow into as E2 onwards fills them with the
component inventory in SPEC §7.6, and it is deliberately not enough for a
chart library — Recharts is most of a budget on its own, so the epic that
adds it raises this number in the pull request that adds it and says what
it bought. A budget generous enough to absorb that silently could not see a
threefold regression today, which is the only thing this gate is for.
Pulse runs inside an LMS iframe, often on campus wifi, and the survey is a
weekly interruption a student did not ask for. A slow first paint is a
